pull_request.title: Tracker: establish Gen3 truth-tracking baseline with Geant4 and Fatras
pull_request.head: codex/tracker-truth-baseline
pull_request.body:
Establish a constant **3 T** ACTS truth-associated Kalman baseline for the exact Gen3 nODD tracker and material map merged in PR100, comparing Geant4 and Fatras at fixed muon pT 1, 10 and 100 GeV.

All **six 20,000-event samples** completed: **119,982/120,000** generated primaries have finite fitted parameters; 14 fail the seven-unique-measurement selection and four Geant4 1 GeV candidates fail fitting. No fitted six-parameter covariance is invalid. Three partial fits fail native truth-matching completeness; they remain in seed-associated residuals with verified unique primary/proto identity and separate native Fake counters.

For **|eta|<0.5**, central 68.27% relative-pT half-widths are **0.543/0.638/0.771%** in Fatras and **1.157/0.791/1.050%** in Geant4 at 1/10/100 GeV. Pulls have substantial non-Gaussian tails, especially Geant4; central and full-SD diagnostics are both retained without clipping. Forward 100 GeV resolution and charge identification degrade strongly in both backends. These results characterize the present model; they do not establish unit pulls or detector acceptance.

An independent **50,000-event Fatras** sample trains the common hit-error table from 699,273 measurements, covering 52 sensitive volumes, 90 measured volume/coordinate pairs and 106 cluster groups. Preserve the unchanged ACTS `error_parameterisation.py` output and an independently audited overflow-group correction. Every one of **3,199,735** written performance-coordinate variances matches frozen SD² exactly after ROOT float conversion.

Pixels use geometric **50×50 µm** cells; short strips **75 µm×0.5 mm**; each actual long-strip face measures one coordinate at **80 µm** pitch. Native 1D geometric digitization works, so the temporary smearing fallback is unused. Task-local adapters correct the pinned truth-index/duplicate-association defects, exclude its unsafe original reference finder, apply errors after clustering, and retain one ordinary Geant4 run with independent per-event seeds. No shared ACTS source, detector geometry, clustered positions or Kalman fitter is changed.

- [Report, ten PNG/PDF/SVGZ figure sets, complete CSV and retained provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/tree/codex/tracker-truth-baseline/docs/validation/truth-tracking-baseline)
- [Full all-eta pull distributions: six track parameters and derived pT, 1/10/100 GeV overlays, complete tails and ±5 views](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/tree/codex/tracker-truth-baseline/docs/validation/truth-tracking-baseline/pulls)
- [Configuration and reproduction commands](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/tree/codex/tracker-truth-baseline/software/analysis/truth_tracking)
- Governing prototype: DES-025; module contracts: DES-007/DES-008; source layout: ADR-008.
- Validation: 25 analytic/native controls passed; retained source/table/count/common-binary audits and figure replay pass. Separate PhysVal reproduced every training group and independently checked the final six-run source/data/figures at f7b14c6: 17,712 scalar statistics, all written variances, all CSV fields and ten original PNGs; no blocking finding for this qualified prototype.

The new all-eta distributions use **(truth − reconstructed)/fitted sigma**, with wrapped phi and full theta–q/p covariance for derived pT. All **119,982** fitted tracks enter each of seven quantities; all **42 histograms** have zero nonfinite entries, underflow and overflow. Full-range variable-bin densities preserve every observed tail; ±5 views use the same full-sample normalization. The unmeasured time parameter is explicitly a seed/fitter-prior diagnostic. Four new analytic controls pass; the portable suite has 24 passes and five expected native-only skips. Independent PhysVal04 at **c3d037a** reproduced all 42 histograms exactly, all 119,982 six-dimensional covariance checks, all 462 CSV fields and visually assessed all six PNG originals; no blocking finding. All 210 moment/extrema comparisons agree within 1.16×10⁻¹⁰.

**PROTOTYPE/DRAFT design status.** Ideal truth seeds and geometric response, one-phi-bin mapped material and locality qualifications remain explicit. Statistics omit training/model systematics. Training observer identity and the older bounded lifecycle comparison are qualified in the report. PR100 and the original baseline retain their own finalized usage accounts. The Gaussian cross-check has a separate canonical account with its coordinator turn now finalized. Available usage and interaction records are current; the active merge-preparation turn remains excluded.

The reviewer-requested **Gaussian-smearing Fatras cross-check** is now complete: another **20,000 events per pT** at 1/10/100 GeV, using all-cluster training widths pooled by volume/coordinate. All **59,989** selected tracks fit, with zero invalid six-dimensional covariances, native Fake fits or final measurement losses. All **1,457,028** measurement-coordinate variances match fixed sigma² exactly. Pooled measurement standardized-residual SDs are **1.000165/0.999683/1.000024**; track-level tails remain (1 GeV q/p pull SD **4.277**, versus **6.990** for geometric digitization). The original reference is preserved.

- [Gaussian-versus-geometric report, seven PNG/PDF/SVGZ figure sets, complete distributions and 42-row CSV](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/tree/codex/tracker-truth-baseline/docs/validation/truth-tracking-baseline/smearing)
- Effective native sensor-bound limit is **10 retries / 11 draw attempts**. Historical reports mistakenly labeled it zero/no retry; their original bytes are retained with explicit corrections. Zero final losses do not exclude retried draws. No simulation or retry setting changed.
- Independent numerical assessment reproduced all training widths, measurement marginals and comparison histograms. Final independent review at **7c9340b** resolved the retry-description finding and found no remaining scientific or provenance blocker; 2,985 scalar statistics agree within 2.22×10⁻¹⁶, and all seven figures were assessed. Portable suite: **34 passed / five expected native-only skips**; native pilots/campaigns and dedicated controls passed.

Closes #102.

issues.title: Tracker: establish the Gen3 truth-tracking performance baseline
issues.body:
Establish the first truth-associated tracking baseline for the PR100 Gen3 nODD tracker and its exact material map, as requested on 2026-10-26.

- Geant4 and Fatras; one muon per event at fixed pT 1, 10 and 100 GeV.
- Constant 3 T ideal field, selected by the human.
- Geometric 50×50 µm pixels, module-default 75 µm×0.5 mm short strips and 80 µm single-coordinate long strips on the physical stereo faces.
- Independent Fatras hit-error training using ACTS error_parameterisation.py, with auditable correction of its pooled-tail/overflow bookkeeping and one frozen table for both backends.
- Native truth-associated Kalman fits; generated denominators, unique measurements, failed fits and covariance failures retained.
- Perigee resolutions and pulls versus eta and pT, replayable figures/data, exact provenance and separate PhysVal assessment.

Implementation and evidence: PR #101. Governing prototype DES-025, module response DES-007/DES-008 and source layout ADR-008. This is a characterization campaign without detector design sign-off, reconstruction acceptance or production geometry changes.

Establish a constant **3 T** ACTS truth-associated Kalman baseline for the exact Gen3 nODD tracker and material map merged in PR100, comparing Geant4 and Fatras at fixed muon pT 1, 10 and 100 GeV.

All **six 20,000-event samples** completed: **119,982/120,000** generated primaries have finite fitted parameters; 14 fail the seven-unique-measurement selection and four Geant4 1 GeV candidates fail fitting. No fitted six-parameter covariance is invalid. Three partial fits fail native truth-matching completeness; they remain in seed-associated residuals with verified unique primary/proto identity and separate native Fake counters.

For **|eta|<0.5**, central 68.27% relative-pT half-widths are **0.543/0.638/0.771%** in Fatras and **1.157/0.791/1.050%** in Geant4 at 1/10/100 GeV. Pulls have substantial non-Gaussian tails, especially Geant4; central and full-SD diagnostics are both retained without clipping. Forward 100 GeV resolution and charge identification degrade strongly in both backends. These results characterize the present model; they do not establish unit pulls or detector acceptance.

An independent **50,000-event Fatras** sample trains the common hit-error table from 699,273 measurements, covering 52 sensitive volumes, 90 measured volume/coordinate pairs and 106 cluster groups. Preserve the unchanged ACTS `error_parameterisation.py` output and an independently audited overflow-group correction. Every one of **3,199,735** written performance-coordinate variances matches frozen SD² exactly after ROOT float conversion.

Pixels use geometric **50×50 µm** cells; short strips **75 µm×0.5 mm**; each actual long-strip face measures one coordinate at **80 µm** pitch. Native 1D geometric digitization works, so the temporary smearing fallback is unused. Task-local adapters correct the pinned truth-index/duplicate-association defects, exclude its unsafe original reference finder, apply errors after clustering, and retain one ordinary Geant4 run with independent per-event seeds. No shared ACTS source, detector geometry, clustered positions or Kalman fitter is changed.

- [Report, ten PNG/PDF/SVGZ figure sets, complete CSV and retained provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/tree/codex/tracker-truth-baseline/docs/validation/truth-tracking-baseline)
- [Full all-eta pull distributions: six track parameters and derived pT, 1/10/100 GeV overlays, complete tails and ±5 views](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/tree/codex/tracker-truth-baseline/docs/validation/truth-tracking-baseline/pulls)
- [Configuration and reproduction commands](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/tree/codex/tracker-truth-baseline/software/analysis/truth_tracking)
- Governing prototype: DES-025; module contracts: DES-007/DES-008; source layout: ADR-008.
- Validation: 25 analytic/native controls passed; retained source/table/count/common-binary audits and figure replay pass. Separate PhysVal reproduced every training group and independently checked the final six-run source/data/figures at f7b14c6: 17,712 scalar statistics, all written variances, all CSV fields and ten original PNGs; no blocking finding for this qualified prototype.

The new all-eta distributions use **(truth − reconstructed)/fitted sigma**, with wrapped phi and full theta–q/p covariance for derived pT. All **119,982** fitted tracks enter each of seven quantities; all **42 histograms** have zero nonfinite entries, underflow and overflow. Full-range variable-bin densities preserve every observed tail; ±5 views use the same full-sample normalization. The unmeasured time parameter is explicitly a seed/fitter-prior diagnostic. Four new analytic controls pass; the portable suite has 24 passes and five expected native-only skips. Independent PhysVal04 at **c3d037a** reproduced all 42 histograms exactly, all 119,982 six-dimensional covariance checks, all 462 CSV fields and visually assessed all six PNG originals; no blocking finding. All 210 moment/extrema comparisons agree within 1.16×10⁻¹⁰.

**PROTOTYPE/DRAFT design status.** Ideal truth seeds and geometric response, one-phi-bin mapped material and locality qualifications remain explicit. Statistics omit training/model systematics. Training observer identity and the older bounded lifecycle comparison are qualified in the report. PR100 and the original baseline retain their own finalized usage accounts. The Gaussian cross-check has a separate canonical account with its coordinator turn now finalized. Available usage and interaction records are current; the active merge-preparation turn remains excluded.

The reviewer-requested **Gaussian-smearing Fatras cross-check** is now complete: another **20,000 events per pT** at 1/10/100 GeV, using all-cluster training widths pooled by volume/coordinate. All **59,989** selected tracks fit, with zero invalid six-dimensional covariances, native Fake fits or final measurement losses. All **1,457,028** measurement-coordinate variances match fixed sigma² exactly. Pooled measurement standardized-residual SDs are **1.000165/0.999683/1.000024**; track-level tails remain (1 GeV q/p pull SD **4.277**, versus **6.990** for geometric digitization). The original reference is preserved.

- [Gaussian-versus-geometric report, seven PNG/PDF/SVGZ figure sets, complete distributions and 42-row CSV](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/tree/codex/tracker-truth-baseline/docs/validation/truth-tracking-baseline/smearing)
- Effective native sensor-bound limit is **10 retries / 11 draw attempts**. Historical reports mistakenly labeled it zero/no retry; their original bytes are retained with explicit corrections. Zero final losses do not exclude retried draws. No simulation or retry setting changed.
- Independent numerical assessment reproduced all training widths, measurement marginals and comparison histograms. Final independent review at **7c9340b** resolved the retry-description finding and found no remaining scientific or provenance blocker; 2,985 scalar statistics agree within 2.22×10⁻¹⁶, and all seven figures were assessed. Portable suite: **34 passed / five expected native-only skips**; native pilots/campaigns and dedicated controls passed.

   ACTS `Examples/Scripts/Digitization/error_parameterisation.py:153–158` computes and appends the exact-size population standard deviation. Lines `174–184` subsequently replace the selected residuals with the pooled `cluster_size >= c_size` residuals, but never recompute or replace the appended value.    I executed the exact pinned cluster loop, with plotting/file operations stubbed. For exact-size residual widths 1 and 4, the early-break JSON value is **1**, while the actual pooled width is **2.9154759474**.

2. **High: capped overflow and unsupported internal sizes need explicit handling.**  
   The same script’s `145–149` loop stops before `break_cluster_size`. With the default cap of 5, absent an earlier break, its last entry describes exact size 4. Native `GeometricConfig.cpp:20–24` applies the last entry to every size ≥4. That overflow group is not pooled by the script. An independent control returned exact-size **4**, whereas the actual pooled ≥4 width was **4.5276925691**. A missing internal cluster size produced **NaN** in the output vector.

   ACTS `Examples/Io/Json/src/JsonDigitizationConfig.cpp:201–212` squares JSON `"rms"` values. `ModuleClusters.cpp:291–325` later constructs geometric variances from cell weights and widths when merging, without retaining the earlier variance-map value.    The estimator is `np.std(res)`, not `sqrt(mean(res²))`. Preserve that convention if making a minimal repair, and record group means separately. It does not correct hit biases.
